newsitem.title: POLAND: BANK KOMUNALNY SEEN EXTENDING DEBUT'S GAIN.
newsitem.headline: BANK KOMUNALNY SEEN EXTENDING DEBUT'S GAIN.

text.p: Polish Bank Komunalny w Gdyni SA, which started trade on the Warsaw bourse on Wednesday at 23 zlotys, 58.6 percent higher than its issue price, is likely to rise over the next few sessions, traders said.
Komunalny traded in a 4.4-million zloty turnover.
"It's likely to keep rising, as will the bourse's better banks," one trader said.
Some analysts had seen Komunalny's debut as high as 30 zlotys but said the overall market trend, currently seen starting a brief downward correction, prevented a bigger jump.
Other analysts said Wednesday's price was a fair one for the bank and expected Komunalny to move along with the overall market.
Bank Komunalny had a 6.5-million-zloty net profit last year on interest and other income of 20.8 million zlotys.
